# IndexedCode

> A local index of one source repository, kept current while files change. It extracts modules, classes, functions, and call/import/inheritance relationships with Tree-sitter, and answers symbol and text queries over HTTP. Results are bounded JSON; source text is read from the index or from disk and marked `current` or `stale`.

This server indexes a single repository and listens on {base}. {auth}

Prefer these endpoints over reading the whole tree: search first, then fetch only the source you need. Responses are capped in size; when `truncated` is true, pass `next_cursor` back to get the next page. A cursor becomes invalid (HTTP 400) if the index changed since it was issued — repeat the original query.

## HTTP API

- [GET {base}/v1/status]({base}/v1/status): Index health — `coverage` (ready/known files, entity count), `pending_jobs`, `stale_paths` (files changed on disk since indexing), `failures`, `model_fingerprint`. Check this first if results look wrong or old.
- [GET {base}/v1/queue]({base}/v1/queue): Work not yet reflected in the index. `jobs[]` each give `path`, `status` (`pending`, `running`, `retry`, `failed`), `queued_at_ms`, `updated_at_ms`, `attempts`, `last_error`, and the `functions` currently indexed in that file that will be re-extracted. Also `last_updated_ms` (when the index last changed), `recent_functions`, and `now_ms` (server clock for computing ages). Results for queued paths may be out of date.
- [POST {base}/v1/search]({base}/v1/search): Body `{"query": str, "mode": "semantic"|"symbol"|"lexical"|"hybrid", "limit": int, "cursor": str}`. Use `semantic` by default - for rag search, `symbol` for an exact function or class name, `lexical` for text inside code. `hybrid` is the default and falls back to lexical when no embedding model is available (`degraded: "semantic_unavailable"`); `semantic` mode errors without a model. Each result has `entity_type`, `entity_id`, `qualified_name`, `path`, `start_line`, `end_line`, `score`, `evidence`.
- [POST {base}/v1/context]({base}/v1/context): Exact source. Body is either `{"entity_type": "function"|"class", "entity_id": int}` using ids from search, or `{"path": "relative/file.py", "start_line": int, "end_line": int}`. Returns `source`, `freshness` (`current`, `stale`, `unindexed`), and for functions the enclosing class and related edges. Paths must be relative to the repository root.
- [POST {base}/v1/references]({base}/v1/references): Body `{"symbol": str, "limit": int}`. Syntactic candidates for imports, calls, inheritance, and usages, each with a `snippet`, `line_number`, and `resolution` (`resolved`, `syntactic_candidate`, `unresolved`). These are name matches, not type-checked resolutions — confirm in the source.
- [POST {base}/v1/graphql]({base}/v1/graphql): Read-only GraphQL. Body `{"query": str, "variables": obj, "operationName": str}`. Query-only (no mutations); introspection is enabled, so ask `__schema` for the full type list. Root lookups: `file(path:)`, `module(path:)`, `class(qualifiedName:)`, `function(qualifiedName:)`. Traversal: `File.classes/functions`, `ClassNode.methods/nestedClasses`, `Module.children/files`, `FunctionNode.callers/callees` (name-resolved call edges), and `related(relation:)` on every node for raw import/call/inherit edges. `semanticSearch(query:, limit:, mode:)` returns scored entries whose `node` field is a polymorphic `File | ClassNode | FunctionNode | Module` — keep traversing from there with inline fragments. GraphQL errors come back HTTP 200 in `errors`; auth and size limits match the REST endpoints. Queries nested deeper than 8 fields are rejected, lists are capped at 1000 rows, and a call target that matches several functions resolves to the one in the caller's file first, then the lowest id.

## Interfaces

- [Web dashboard]({base}/): Live view of the queue, queued functions, update times, and search, for people.
- MCP (stdio): `indexedcode-mcp --root <repo> --db <index.sqlite>` exposes `code_search`, `code_context`, `code_references`, `code_status` with the same behavior as the endpoints above.

## Notes

- Read-only: nothing here modifies the repository or runs code.
- Only supported languages are indexed (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, C, C++). Binary, oversized, ignored (`.gitignore`, `node_modules`, `build`, ...) and symlinked files are skipped.
- Line numbers are 1-based. Times are Unix milliseconds.
- Full documentation: https://github.com/the-michael-albert/indexedcode#readme
